display_name: DURA 尾部保护七景测试
description: 冻结 DURA，独立训练多尺度修正；以合法源 IQ 同条相对 DURA 的尾部超额误差加权，检查全量七景识别。
authorization: User requests continued novel and DURA-combinable Phase1 restoration research, F-free/TX-label-free source training, automatic seven-view test and truth-last score.

code.environment: N607 physical GPU7, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=7, FP32 TF32 off; source prepare batch 32, train batch 32, ground/scoring CPU 2 threads

data.representation: frozen candidate + frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL on fixed Phase1 seven-view ground IQ
data.tx_sets_ref: No target labels, clean pair, or target fitting during inference; labels only after all seven predictions

roles.L_s: source IQ training only, TX hidden
roles.U_s: source IQ training only, TX hidden
roles.test: fixed Phase1 ground IQ, truth last

data.validation_ref: 7840 RX4/6 source validation and 3921 RX8 source holdout, previously seen in other source views
data.support_query_ref: Phase1 original fixed cross_rx126000 and cross_both42000; no support
data.leo_config_ref: R07 2.462 GHz source views and Phase1 six fixed practical test views
data.target_panel: 168000 Phase1 physical records x seven views
data.actual_training_labels: Recovery training uses paired source IQ only; no F outputs, F weights, TX labels, V or target. Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL only after recovery checkpoint frozen.
data.augmentation: Fixed pre-existing Phase1 ground test simulated seven views

permissions.query_use: Fixed per-record Phase1 IQ only after source training; no target fit, truth only after seven-view predictions
permissions.claim_scope: Single-seed repeatedly observed Phase1 simulated ground test; not independent blind or real satellite

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen source-only DURA v1.0; fresh independently initialized zero-head multiscale correction
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: DURA provenance checked by frozen_dura; deterministic source context cache uses matching ordered 8192 fit IDs and source-only data contract
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: DURA is source-only with matching data contract and no target ancestry; correction independently initialized
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final epoch 5; no source or target performance selection

execution.gpu_policy: Physical GPU7, at most one this-run worker and at most 3 total compute workers including others; check capacity; preserve all other owners
execution.stop_rule: Stop exact owner only for source contract/role mismatch, nonfinite computation, incorrect checkpoint, target leakage or unrecoverable technical failure. Preserve all artifacts.

metric_names: raw clean gap in pp and relative percent
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: independent CPU subprocess ground score after seven complete predictions

rows.method: Multiscale DURA correction with source per-batch worst-quarter positive excess versus frozen DURA, weight 0.5
rows.purpose: Complete mandatory Phase1 seven-view test and paired DURA comparison
rows.seed_notes: Correction seed 2026110612, source fit seed 2026110611, order seed 2026110613; fixed DURA seed 2026092701.
rows.scenario: clean and six practical Phase1 Main split views
rows.budget_ref: 168000 physical records x seven views, batch 8

notes: Fixed original source IQ loss and DURA guard plus 0.5 times mean of the worst quarter of per-batch nonnegative source waveform error excess versus frozen DURA; at equality the added tail gradient is zero.
No TX labels, F weights or outputs, V or target used in training; the tail ranks only source paired IQ error and is not a TX identity metric.
8192 source IDs, three fixed views, five epochs, AdamW learning rate 0.0003 weight decay 0.001; deterministic GPU with cached source context.
Fixed final epoch regardless of source or target scores; all 168000 records in each of seven Phase1 views predicted before independent truth-last scoring with frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL.
The tail is relative waveform error rather than identity loss; it may overemphasize high-noise examples or protect DURA without yielding improvements.
